sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Ratnesh Trivedi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Irshad Ali,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material available on record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner for quashing the entire proceedings of complaint case no.346-E/19 [State v. Vinay Kumar Pal and another] under Sections 26(2)(i)/59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 relating to Police Station Laharpur, District Sitapur pending in the court of the First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sitapur as well as summoning order dated 17.7.2019 passed by the First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sitapur so far as it relates to the petitioner.

sentences.text: petitioner may be permitted to surrender and move bail application, before the court concerned and suitable directions may be issued that same may be heard and decided expeditiously, in accordance to law.
Learned A.G.A. has no objection in grant of aforesaid prayer.

In view of above, it is provided that if the petitioner surrenders before the courts below within thirty days from today, and applies for bail, his application for bail shall be considered and decided by the courts below in view of the settled law laid down by the Full Bench of this Court in the case of Amrawati & Another Vs. State of U.P. reported in 2004 (57) ALR 290, as affirmed by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Lal Kamlendra Pratap Singh Vs. State of U.P. reported in 2009 (3) ADJ 322 (SC).

sentences.text: It is made clear that this order shall not be treated as an implied direction of this Court to grant bail to the petitioner and the court concerned shall be at liberty to pass appropriate order in accordance to law.
Till the aforesaid period of thirty days, no coercive measures shall be taken against the petitioner in the aforesaid case.
With above directions, this petition stands disposed of.
